title: Bee Removal in Belmont, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Belmont, Bronx. Licensed nest treatment and removal. Serving Arthur Avenue. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Belmont, known as the Bronx's Little Italy, faces stinging-insect pressure from wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees that nest in the neighborhood's historic rowhouses, restaurant eaves along Arthur Avenue, and residential structures. An active nest in a soffit, wall void, or attic won't resolve on its own — it requires identification, treatment, nest removal, and entry-point sealing. We provide licensed wasp and hornet removal throughout Belmont, from East 187th Street to Fordham Road, with honeybee colonies referred to a licensed beekeeper.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC specializes in Belmont's diverse building types, from pre-war apartments to commercial storefronts along Arthur Avenue. Our licensed technicians understand the neighborhood's architecture and provide same-day emergency service to keep your property safe and bee-free.
localContext: Belmont's outdoor dining along Arthur Avenue, proximity to the Bronx Zoo, and residential gardens — including those near Our Lady of Mount Carmel Church — create nesting opportunities for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets during spring and summer. The neighborhood's rowhouses and multi-story buildings offer sheltered entry points into wall voids, soffits, and attic spaces where paper wasp and hornet colonies build nests the size of basketballs. The outdoor markets and restaurant patios attract foraging yellow jackets, and older wood trim on historic structures invites carpenter bee galleries.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Belmont?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — a ground-level yellow jacket nest in an accessible area costs less than a hornet nest inside a third-floor wall void in one of Belmont's multi-story buildings. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Belmont?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in Belmont?
faqs.answer: Most wasp and hornet nest treatments in Belmont — including along Arthur Avenue and the surrounding residential streets — are completed within 1–2 hours once the entry point is located. Same-day service is often available; call (855) 930-5016 to schedule.

faqs.question: What types of properties in Belmont do you service for stinging-insect removal?
faqs.answer: We service all property types in Belmont: historic rowhouses, apartment buildings, restaurants and cafes along Arthur Avenue, retail shops, outdoor market structures, and commercial spaces near Fordham University. Our licensed technicians treat nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, rooftops, eaves over outdoor seating areas, and carpenter bee galleries in wood trim.
